reviews.text: You guys are amazing! Thank you so much
EXCELLENT!!!  100 SATISFIED -- THANKS!!!!

First time rescue visit. Was absolutely stellar, and everyone was helpful, friendly, and supportive. As a rescue, we could not have asked for a more welcoming clinic.
Appreciate all you do for every animal who comes into your clinic!
And LOVE the walk up pharmacy window. Simply awesome.

Booked a first visit for vaccines as a new client. No one told us, when booking or before the visit, what records they needed. I brought the records I had just in case, but they weren't current, so we waited about an hour while the clinic got updated ones from our previous vet.
When I asked why this wasn't requested ahead of time, the front desk said owners usually bring records and that online booking "wouldn't know to ask." That's exactly the problem: new-patient intake should request current records, whether you book online or by phone. Instead of acknowledging the gap, staff argued with me about it, and the doctor seemed annoyed with me when he came in, even though the delay came from their process.
A simple heads-up would have saved everyone an hour. I hope they fix their intake process.

Everyone here is so caring and sweet, the staff and polite and respectful and the doctors and technicians are all very knowledgeable and caring, feeling blessed to be able to go back to this amazing team after moving back to the area
I wouldn't take my dog and cat anywhere else. Dr. Matt Lockhart has been my vet for quite a while and he is the best!!
Wonderful vet office all around.
Amazing vets! Have always taken amazing care of my pup.

I have been bringing my pup to Sherman Oaks Vet Group since I got him at 12 weeks old. He’s currently 7 years old. He has been treated by just about every vet at the facility. Starting with Dr. Slate, to Dr. Richter, the other Dr. Richter, to Dr. Lockhart. They have all attended to him with grace and care. All incredible doctors.

More recently, we had an unsuspecting health scare. My dog had gotten neutered, and a week later stopped walking. Given his breed, we feared it could be a host of other things. I rushed him to this facility and encountered Dr. Dumas, and he was absolutely heaven sent. He approached finding out what was wrong with a level of precision and care that i don’t even have words to explain. I was literally weeping in the room and the entire staff with the doctor not only took the utmost care of my dog, but of me. They got to the bottom of what was wrong, put him on a treatment plan, and had beyond stellar bedside manner. They even called to check on my dog repeatedly over a few weeks to make sure everything was going according to plan. Dr. Dumas is a champion!

Incredible staff, incredible doctors, would recommend them over any and everyone.
Thy came to my car and got my doggies and returned them as I am handicapped.
Dr. Kensington was so kind, caring, thorough, professional, and took the time to explain everything. Highly recommend, you’ll be in great hands!

Dr. Kensington was truly an incredible veterinarian throughout Charlie girl’s entire journey. From the beginning, she was compassionate, patient, and genuinely cared about Charlie and our family. She took the time to explain everything, answer all of my questions, and always made me feel like Charlie was in the best hands possible.
Even during the hardest part of Charlie’s journey, Dr. Kensington was there with kindness and understanding. Saying goodbye to Charlie was one of the hardest things I’ve ever had to do, but I’m so grateful she was the person helping us through it.
I will forever be thankful for the care, compassion, and love she showed Charlie. She is truly an exceptional veterinarian, and I highly recommend her to anyone looking for someone who treats their patients like family. 🤍

This is the best veterinary practice in LA. I’ve been to 6 others over the years based on what neighborhood I’ve lived in and no matter where I end up, I will never use another practice.

The space is clean but also inviting.
The prices actually make sense.
They actually care about animals.
They are incredibly knowledgeable.

I genuinely think my dog would have lived longer had I found them sooner. Towards the end, the kindness that they showed my dog, me, and my whole family was nothing short of remarkable. Whenever I would have to show up to get more medicine, IVs, etc the staff always seemed to be personally familiar with the case - whether they were or not, they make you feel like a person.

Every time I drive past, I still feel so grateful for the care they gave my little guy.

MY DOG COULDN’T MOVE AFTER A VISIT HERE.
I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this clinic and would strongly advise other pet owners to think twice before bringing their animals here.

I brought my dog in for a routine checkup, including blood work, ear cleaning, and a prostate exam. He was taken to the back without me. When he returned, he was visibly stressed, but I assumed it was simply because he dislikes the vet. Once we got home, however, he became extremely lethargic, refused to eat or drink, and could barely move.

I immediately called the clinic, terrified and looking for answers. After being disconnected and placed on hold multiple times, I finally spoke with Dr. Shannon Khodad. Instead of taking my concerns seriously, she told me he was “just stressed,” that I should go to an emergency vet if I was that concerned, and told me not to come to the reception desk and “make a scene.” I found this response incredibly dismissive and unprofessional.

I also requested to see the camera footage from the area where my dog had been taken because I wanted to make sure nothing had happened to him. I was initially told there were no cameras. Then I was told the cameras weren’t working. Later, I was told the cameras were simply pointed at a corner of the room. The changing explanations were extremely concerning and did nothing to reassure me that my dog had been properly cared for.

What followed was even more concerning. I was initially told my dog had IVDD based on his X-rays. After spending thousands of dollars on medications, neurological consultations, and laser therapy—and losing approximately three weeks of work—another veterinarian determined that the actual problem was in his neck, which made much more sense given that he could barely turn his neck.

Despite speaking with the clinic manager, I received no meaningful follow-up or explanation about what happened.

I understand that veterinary medicine can involve difficult diagnoses, but the way my concerns were handled, the dismissive communication, the changing explanations, and lack of accountability were unacceptable. When your animal is suddenly sick after being in a clinic’s care, you expect compassion, communication, and genuine concern—not to be treated like you are “making a scene.”

I will never bring my dog back here and cannot recommend this clinic to anyone. I will also be reaching out to the California Veterinary Medical Board regarding my experience.

Dr. Khodadad is great. She’s got cat girl energy. Very thorough and really takes the time to get to know your pet. Our girl is 17, has CKD, and issues with constipation. She’s been super helpful with her treatment and advice. She’s calm, direct, and professional. We’ve had great care from her and she also helped us out when we expressed our anxiety when taking vacations. She introduced us to our now cat sitter who also works there and it’s really eased our worries.

We’ve seen 3 of the vets so far and she’s our favorite. Dr. Goss was also awesome and had great bedside manner. He gave us some really thoughtful advice on accessing her quality of life and how we know when it’s time.

This place can be super busy and hectic but we get great 1:1 time with the vets and it’s worth the wait.

Amazing care and skilled medical professionals!! The people here care and do as good as I can hope for my pet in an emergency.

I will always come here when it’s an option
Best vets ever! They really take time to answer questions. They've saved my boy more than once and I can't thank them enough!

I have had four feral cats that have lived in my backyard for roughly 7 years. One day, a female cat showed up. Within a few days, she had babies. I have been feeding them ever since.

There have been a few times when one of them gets sick. I catch the cat and take her for treatment.

Additionally, in the beginning, I paid a bit of $$$ for cat catchers to come to my house. They were caught and taken to their vet. They were fixed.

Even though they live in my backyard and I feed them, I don't consider them my pets; I just try to do my part by feeding them and providing a place for them to live. After all, they are life!

Also, over the past 25 years, I have spent many thousands of dollars to treat animals that are not mine, including the two dogs I had and an indoor cat.

My complaint is that, as people who went to school to treat animals, I would think that they love animals. Every time I take one of these cats to them, or a time I found a little dog on the street that was seriously injured. I took the little dog to them, which cost me over $4 thousand for treatment, even though I had no clue who the dog belonged to.

There are other people like myself who help the animals. We are trying to do our part; why can't these veterinarians do their part and give us a financial break every time I take an animal in that is not mine?

They certainly make a nice living treating animals, and their practice is constantly full. You might want to give back a bit by assisting people like myself who take in stray animals.

Thank you!

This is overall an excellent pet medical facility. The Doctors are attentive and listen and respect your decisions for your fury babies care. Some vets are just billing funnels that lead to black holes where they don't even provide real service. This place is different.  It doesn't matter if you are in for regular a check up, or to get medications, vaccines, and especially during emergencies they are really super professional and do excellent work.  The staff is pretty awesome and knowledgeable.  The staff is friendly and the place is usually busy. Because they are quite good. I strongly recommend this clinic, it is best I have seen this far in LA. Keep up the good work guys. As you can see my sweet baby girl daughter was not happy about getting shots, eye drops, allergy. A treat fixed that, plus I remind myself she might be upset for an hour or two, but she would be miserable if I didn't take her to the vet.
Best team of Veterinary professionals.  I trust them with my furry baby's health and value their opinion about the treatment. They always take good care of Tuzik.
Very friendly staff. Dr Matt especially nice and skilled w my new puppy. I would highly recommend this Vet Group.

I really, really love this place. The only reason I didn't give it five stars is because sometimes the people behind the counter are not rude, but very firm when it comes to the knowledge of you as a pet owner, knowing your pet. Sometimes you know your pet better than they do because they know the pet from a medical POV not from living with them. But kudos to Dr. Lockhart and Dr. Dumas and all the staff… Thank you for always taking care of my little ones. They are a little expensive, but I believe you pay what you get for especially when it comes to your pets care… Dr. Lockhart saved our little puppies life and I trust no one else with my dogs.
Love Dr. Dumas! He really takes care of my pups so well. Very easy to get in and out of the clinic whenever I need to.

Dr. Lockhart was wonderful when he came to my home to  euthanize Toby, my 16 1/2 year old Yorkie.  Toby was a therapy dog , his main gig was at Cedars for 12 years. He received the White House Service Award from President Obama and deserved the best sendoff  possible , which was what he received from Dr Lockhart I now have a new puppy and he is under Dr. Lockhart's wonderful care.
awesome place great people and very friendly

I just went with my friend to have her dog’s eye checked for pink eye, and had a horrible interaction with one of the vets, Shannon Khodadad. She had initially stated that she was going to do eye tests. She came back only a few moments later, but had said that the test went well, and something about her ears- but followed that up with “There were dogs in the back, so I didn’t want her waiting with them.” My friend asked what did you do then if not the eye tests? The vet responded quickly and condescendingly, saying “I did a physical. That is what you do when you…when you come to a vet…” My friend responded with: “Oh- I just didn’t know what that entailed.” Dr. Khodadad then responded by rolling her eyes and said “Okay”, in an aggravated tone. Mind you- my friend remained calm and had a neutral tone the entire interaction. The micro-aggression was utterly uncalled for- and not to be vulgar, but blatantly bitchy to be honest. I will add though, the assistant male vet was incredibly corporative and cordial towards us, though. And made our experience overall better. As well as doctor Ritcher, who took over for Khodadad. Who was much more professional and straightforward. I don’t know if Dr. Khodadad was having a bad day or just had a personal agenda towards my friend, but that behavior is totally unacceptable in a place of business, and her and I were utterly flabbergasted by her attitude.

Dr. Lockhart has provided exceptional care for my dog, Codey, and I couldn’t be more grateful. From the moment we walk through the door, Dr. Lockhart and the entire team are kind, professional, and genuinely compassionate. Highly recommended!
All the staff is super friendly and supportive each visit and provides best recommendation not pressuring to do everything just because.
great CAT doctor
This vet has been consistently great through many years of care for 3 dogs.

Highly recommended! I’m so happy I found out about this clinic through my recently adopted kitten’s foster mom, who works there. Everyone is very professional, friendly, and genuinely caring.
I truly appreciate the way they treat both the pets and their owners with so much kindness.
Dr. Goss is very attentive and knowledgable. He took the time getting to know our dog and giving us the best medical advice. Front office was very friendly and accommodating.

My 3 dogs are moving to Hawaii with me. Anna was very knowledgeable about what needed to be done - rabies shots, titer test, medical certificate form, and flea application. Every thing was done in a timely manner so we are ready to fly in 4 days. Without her guidance, it would have been aLockhart. difficult process. Thank you to Anna and Dr. Lockheart.
Amazing doctors, caring staff and very accommodating. Hours are great too

We had a great first visit and diagnostic experience. The office was calm and welcoming, and each of the staff members I engaged with was very helpful. Dr. Dumas provided clear explanations of all of our options and was able to efficiently diagnose what has been going on with our dog's health. Our dog can be very shy, and she warmed up to Dr. Dumas with no issues. Thank you very much to the awesome team at Sherman Oaks Vet Group- we're happy to have found our new vet in LA.
Love the Doctors!

Had to retire & moved to the other side of town close to the rest of family.
Our wonderful Lab suddenly got very ill; now our Vet of years is very far away.  We decided to take a chance and to take him close by "down the hill" to "somebody."    Turned out we were totally unannounced, because I
had some phone numbers confused and had called some place altogether different.  A very sweet and helpful, knowledgable young lady doctor, Alex,  took care of us right away … unfortunately the cancer had
caught up with our wonderful friend.  It has not helped our new home situation that our younger, very loving  & extra alert none bribable terrier-
mix little lady has also been troubled with growths and  needed serious
help with one also very suddenly over growing and opening … just brought
her home from surgery.  It all went well, well cared for too. both doggie and we.  The necessary incision is huge, a big wound, but she is chipper
and happy … and alert   Of course my pocket book got sort o'emptied, but
… never mind the doctor … our doggie earned it as well.   Hopefully we shall enjoy each other for a number of years to come.  Despite all the heart and head aches, we feel lucky to have found "our new vet care."      .
We thank you, especially Cobbeau and Emma Lulu, I'm sure.

April 19, 2018   Our Emma Lou ... Lulu... went to heaven now ... she was a very special 'little' dog (medium size actually.)  She was so loyal, protective and sweet and so very aware -guess smart that means- and we miss her so very much.  Thank you for your caring preparations, the comfy and pretty little bed on the floor, and, your considerate card you sent us.  (No more doggies for now ...  should also be mentioned that our grief was much respected and no charge for the service.)
Sincerely, Irmie Sofroniew and Christian Plata
Usually good but they tend to patronize the dog owners.
Dr. Lockhart always puts me at ease when it comes to care of my cat, Pancakes. I always feel like she’s in good hands, thanks to him.
This is a wonderful veterinary group with outstanding doctors. They really take excellent care of their patients !

Everyone we met at this office has been kind, understanding, considerate and empathetic not only to us, the owners, but moreso our scared Chihuahua. I highly recommend this office as they really do care and are incredibly loving.
Great customer service and friendly staff. Very professional people
Always a pleasant experience for my pup Clara and for myself. Professional and cautious and always happy to answer any questions I may have regarding  Clara's health.
Overall, I am very pleased with the care my dogs receive, especially if I get to see Dr. Andrea. I also like Dr. Kensington.

Do NOT take your pets here!!  WARNING - PLEASE READ!!! I had been taking my two frenchies here for years for allergy meds and basic health matters (ear infections, vaccines, upset stomach, etc).  We took our 7 yo frenchie in for an upset stomach and were told there was a foreign body in his stomach.  Andrea Richter called me several times stating there is a towel or tampon in his stomach.  I said there's no way - he has never eaten anything like that and his tongue is too big, he can't swallow it.  I agreed to an ultrasound to prove it was not a foreign body.  Andrea called me after she received the ultrasound results (which we were NOT allowed to view) and told me the ultrasound confirmed the foreign body.  She said it was life or death and he HAD to have surgery.  We had no other choice than to believe her and go through with the surgery.  HOWEVER - it was ALL A LIE!  There was NO foreign body.  There was nothing in his stomach.  The cut into his stomach and intestines and found nothing - except he had a bad flare up of IBS, which he had already been treated for/diagnosed with 3 months prior.  When we finally received the ultrasound results they clearly state that THERE WAS NO FOREIGN BODY!  The ultrasound said that the do not see a foreign body but they recommend an "Exploratory surgery".  We were NEVER told this and the vet continues to lie their way out of what they did.  $12,000 later and even worse - my poor pup went through a completely unnecessary surgery for their gain.  PLUS - this vet still has NOT provided us with any records on the surgery.  I do not know WHO performed the surgery.  The incision was terrible - I could have done better.  RUN AWAY FROM HERE!  I am never going back and just trying to spread the word to avoid this con artists.  They are only in this for their financial gain.  They DO NOT CARE ABOUT YOUR PET!  And, I should add - when we confronted Weston Richter & Andrea Richter after the fact about being misled and forced into the surgery, their response was "We should be grateful our dog is alive".  That's who these people are.  There is a special place in hell for them.  This case is being reviewed by the California State Veterinary Board, whom I spoke with again yesterday, it they will be held responsible.  Save your pets and your money and go anywhere else!

Coming  to Sherman Oaks Veterinary felt like my vet in SF at Arguello Pet hospital which is also Family Owned.  Bringing my new foster felt good and that I would make it my new Vet for my other two Dogs !!  - Until I met JAN!!!  And after her entitled style of control and rudeness- I can see it is not family Run  but JAN Run and She is not about everyone having a good experience- as she was not busy at the time nor was there many people waiting.

She literally told me that family run means it’s not a corporation so she can treat people as she wants because the owner won’t call me back and trusts her explicitly ~ who says that to anyone caring ?  It was like a bully rather than a place that cares about animals or the owners… so yukky!!  Yelp is more accurate in its reviews as it mentions often how rude the staff is but could not imagine this elderly woman Jan being like a tyrant in a pet hospital??!

She’s burnt out, acts entitled and doesn’t value Pet parents and nor does she care for fosters and their care for their dogs because even fosters become regulars for their dogs that they care deeply about.  but believes she owns the place because the owners can’t hear the complaints because she bullies and is condescending to those who do call her out for being rude and dropping the ball on caring - No Thanks

Dr Lockhart and the team at Sherman Oaks Vet have been great for our cat! They have flexible appointment hours and also take walk in’s. They’re very invested in the wellbeing and care of their patients

I can not say enough good things about Sherman Oaks Vet group, I have always received amazing help from the minute you walk thru the doors. The staff are polite and efficient. Doc’s are great. Getting into a room even if you are a walk in isn’t painful. But most of all the pets are not simply numbers, they treat them like they are children. Very aware that they are our children. I have recommended at least 10 friends/other dog parents to them for their young pups to be spayed or neutered all with extremely happy results…test are done on the same day as the surgery (no 2 trips) so yes I am a for life customer of SOVG!
This place is the best!  So happy we started bringing our dog here ever since we moved to Sherman Oaks.

Dr. Weston Richter and his team are thorough, caring and experts in their field.  My trust them with my little senior Yorkie implicitly, and she is living her best life possible, despite ailments.  Follow up calls by Dr. Richter in an extremely timely fashion (I'm quite sure that he calls on his days off too) are genuinely appreciated.

Sherman Oaks Veterinary Group has always been there for us. The staff and doctors are professional and kind and ready to answer our questions patiently. They have flexible hours, and we're usually in and out pretty fast. I highly recommend this vet, especially if you want great service and the proper care for your animal!
Staff and Dr.'s are great and knowledgeable.  Takes great care of my little girl.

Very clean and professional.  The manager is kind. Dr Lockhart is very knowledgeable and engaged. He is very considerate of my pets comfort during our frequent visits. Love Jee the tech as well. She is very caring.
Caring staff and vets.  Always take great care of my babies.  Have been going there for at least 30 years.
Great medical care for our pets for over 20 years. We feel so safe and confident in in the treatment of our pets' care here.
professional and caring

Dr. Goss and the staff at Sherman Oaks Vet group are amazing. They always take such great care of both of my dogs. I always feel taken care of and all my questions are always addressed. I recommend them to everyone I know with pets.

I cannot say enough great things about Dr. Dumas and his patient care.  I have three different fur babies, a variety of ages, and his professionalism, care of his patients, and ability to articulate what's going on to the humans is one of the best.  Whether it is a routine wellness check or a full blown dental for my senior dog with a stage 5 heart murmur at 17 years, with zero complications...you're in the right hands and the right veterinary group.  This will be our furrrever home.  (Had to.)

As a relatively new client of SOVG, I am thrilled to report how much we love this veterinary office. The staff is instantly welcoming, the wait time is usually very short, the vets are extremely knowledgeable and gentle, the techs are wonderful, professional and gentle, and the pricing is fair.  We have been to several veterinary offices over the years and find SOVG to be the absolute best.
The doctor is Amazing and all that helped with our cat were so kind and helpful.

I use to recommend this place. I wont ever again. The staff is mean and rude and they upcharge you once you're in the door. Front desk staff is green an unknowledgable and unqualified to answer the phone. The quality of care has gone way down.
I would recommend Sherman Oaks Veterinary Group to anyone and everyone looking for quality healthcare for their furry family members, delivered in a warm, family-like atmosphere.

They dismissed my cat bc of her age spent almost 1200 on tests that were inconclusive. The second they found out she was ten they put all the symptoms on her age.Had to take her to the ER where they told me what to do don’t go here with older cats
SOVG filled with excellent vets and extremely friendly staff. I am leaving VCA for them.

I was visiting my daughter and my dog was displaying all signs of an ear infection.  My own vet could not accommodate our need to be seen immediately so I called the Sherman Oaks Veterinary Group and they said they would see my baby that morning itself.  Few hours later I had my baby checked by a vet, treated and brought home.  Dr. Dumas (vet) knew exactly how to deal with my "dramatic" dog, and the staff were so friendly and helpful. It is also a one-stop shop with a pharmacy and all services in one place. Also, the prices were very reasonable. If I lived in the area, they would be my primary vet in a heartbeat! If you live in the area, do check them out!
Amazing hospital definitely recommend youre furry companion to seek care there

I had an emergency with my dog and was not near his usual vet, I called Sherman Oaks Vet and they told me I could come in right away. When I got there everyone was very kind and patient with me, while I freaked out. I had to leave my dog overnight, which I've never done before, but he was definitely in good hands. Dr. Lockhart was great and I am so thankful for him. All the staff was awesome.

I have had nothing but great experiences with them. They once saved my dog after he swallowed a mysterious toy that appeared in our yard and needed emergency surgery. They’ve also helped my other dog with his chronic arthritis. Dr. Richter (the man, there’s also a female Dr. Richter who we’ve never seen before) is the best!!

We absolutely love Sherman Oaks Veterinary Group. Everyone is kind. My number one most favorite thing is that we can always bring the dog right away in the morning if we fear there’s an issue. The peace of mind that gives me is immeasurable.

This place is like a fantasy. The vet is actually normal, informative, and empowers dog owners. Dr. Andy actually listened to me, considered what I was saying, and was willing to work with me. Her confidence in her dad’s abilities in orthopedics and decisions around whether surgeries are actually needed were heart warming and made me feel more like my dog would be treated as part of the family rather than a card to swipe. They are by far the most flexibly serviced practice I’ve encountered- you can walk in for everything, they’re open 7 days a week (which is super important to those of us with special needs fur babies), pricing is reasonable, and there’s time set on Thursdays specifically for walk in vaccinations so you can avoid the crowd. I really just had such a great experience here after a slew of horror stories at other LA area vets and ERs. It’s like God answered my prayers. Plus, bonus points for having David Bowie as the waiting music lol 6/7 times I called, I was able to speak to someone who was patient, answered all my questions and didn’t give me the run around on pricing. The staff is friendly and personable. Like legit friendly, not fake friendly and not like I’m ruining their day by existing. I really love this place. It’s also very clean, modern, and parking is easy.

I previously gave this vet five stars. I've been coming here for years. I'm NEVER coming back. ITS A SCAM.

They don't know what they are doing. They charge SO MUCH and just are throwing darts at a wall. I brought my cat in for vomiting and they tried to have me give her an injection for bacterial infection and skin disorder, which they didn't diagnose her for. When I asked about it, yes I was a little upset, Dr. Dumas was rude and dismissive. He even admitted he had no idea what was going on so he was just throwing everything out there because maybe something might work. At that point, why not just give her dewormer, FIV meds, cancer treatment, etc. I mean, they have no idea what's wrong and are throwing in completely inappropriate treatments for undiagnosed issues. It's like someone goes to the doctor with a broken bone and they give them anti transplant rejecting drugs. Just because "we don't have a clue so let's charge you for everything"

I am beyond upset. They waste so much time. The original blood test malfunctioned and EVERYTHING came back normal but sure, let's just throw treatment for things they didn't diagnose.

I am never coming back . I was a dedicated customer for OVER A DECADE.

Dr Dumas has no compassion. No care. He just gives all the drugs so that something works with NO REGARD for the animal itself. And when I asked why, I was told "well we did the same last time." Yeah, last time I didn't bother to ask questions because I TRUSTED. My mistake. My absolute mistake.

The rudeness Dr. Dumas met with me is beyond unprofessional. Yes, I was upset, but it's my animal who is being treated for a sickness she JUST HAD and it wasn't resolved last time. So why do the same stuff that didn't work? Because of money. That's why. Because they just throw everything to see what sticks. Because there is no actual thought that goes into this. No diagnosis. Nothing. I cannot believe the attitude I was given by Dr. Dumas. He couldn't even answer why he was trying to give covenia because "well it's a broad spectrum antibiotic" (she didn't NEED an antibiotic was my continued question that he kept ignoring). Not one single answer. At all.

Do not come here if you value an actual diagnosis or legit treatment. If you have money to waste, great place. If you expect real answers, you'll be SOL.

Beyond disappointed with Dr. Dumas' attitude and demeanor. I am beyond upset with the lack of transparency. I was told "five more minutes" for over an hour. The test malfunctioned and they had to draw more blood, which I barely believe it malfunctioned, and if it did, it just shows the "quality" of this location. I arrived before 9:00 and left after 11:00 with no diagnosis. I left with the exact same knowledge I came in with, that she has an upset stomach. No knowledge was gained but $500 was taken.

As a side note, I was here a month ago with a cat that had skin cancer, basal cell carcinoma, that cost me over $2,000. Again, I was happy to pay because my cat means the world to me, but I knew they were scamming me with some costs. When I came back for suture removal, a process they told me would take 5 minutes, they held my cat from me for nearly an hour. I had called ahead to ensure they were ready, I was promised it was a good time, yet fitting with this location, I was lied to.

There is no diagnosis. There is no treatment. There is throw it at the wall and see what sticks. There is lets just charged for everything, hope they don't question it, and pray something works even though they didn't even diagnose what they are "treating"

I have never been so upset about veterinary Care. Dr. Dumas needs to realize he is a doctor and his job is to answer questions, not to give sass back when asked "hey why are you giving this when it is for a completely different condition?"

Unprofessional. Unacceptable.

I brought one of my cats in because she was sneezing, wheezing, and one side of her little face was swollen. Wonderful Dr. K correctly diagnosed her with a rare fungal infection in her lungs, and she also comforted me when I was scared for my cat’s health. My cats are everything to me, and this clinic shows that they know that. My cat has been on daily meds for a few months now and she is doing much better, thankfully. All of our follow-up visits have been good, too. I also brought my other cat in for a checkup, and Dr. Sam was so sweet with him. It was wonderful to meet both vets, and they were great with follow-up phone calls and texts to get me results quickly. Everyone at reception is so helpful too, they helped me submit everything to my insurance so I could get reimbursed. This is a great clinic with amazing staff. I’ve been to vets in the past that I didn’t love, but this clinic is so high quality, I would trust them with any issues my kitties were having. What a gem to have here in the Valley. Thank you!!

I feel they overcharged you for things not needed..almost got a fee of 500$..didnt want to go for it when in other vet they have reasonable prices.. the good thing they attended me kindly i will say that..

Exceptional Veterinary Care That Saved Our Dog’s Life:

We adopted our puppy from LA City Animal Services (North Central) and eagerly awaited her spay appointment, which was a prerequisite for bringing her home. The wait for the procedure lasted over a week.

Unfortunately, on the morning of the scheduled procedure, we were informed she was ill—though the staff at LA City Animal Services couldn’t specify what was wrong. When we arrived at the shelter, it was clear she was in critical condition: blue gums, vomiting, tremors, and unable to move. Despite the severity, we honored our commitment to adopt her and rushed her to Sherman Oaks.

Dr. Andrea Richter  took immediate control of the situation. She placed the dog on IV drips, performed blood tests and X-rays, using a methodical process of elimination to identify the issue. Her sharp clinical instincts led her to recommend an urgent ultrasound in Woodland Hills, which revealed a massive intestinal obstruction. Thanks to her quick thinking, we were able to move forward with emergency surgery.

Dr. Weston Richter, equally skilled and compassionate, took on the high-risk procedure. Our puppy was in septic shock, and the odds were against her. Dr. Weston used a carefully calibrated mix of general and local anesthesia to minimize risk and successfully removed a 2-inch corn cob— likely ingested days or weeks before her rescue. The team continued intensive care, including plasma infusions, and within three days, her condition stabilized.

Their ability to make sound, high-stakes decisions under pressure was nothing short of extraordinary. They didn’t shy away from the challenge or opt for the easy route—they acted with precision, courage, and care. Every test and procedure was clearly explained and only pursued when medically necessary. The costs were transparent and aligned with her improving prognosis. It totaled about 11k, which I deem very reasonable given the scope of the medical interventions.

A key point to emphasize is that our dog’s survival was far from guaranteed—in fact, it was highly unlikely. Taking her on as a patient was a significant risk for the veterinary team. Had things gone poorly, which was a real possibility, they would have faced understandably heartbroken and upset pet parents. But instead of choosing the safer path and opting out, the vets made a bold and compassionate decision: they prioritized the dog’s care and did everything possible to improve her chances of survival. Their willingness to act decisively in such a high-risk situation speaks volumes about their professionalism, integrity, and dedication to their patients.

We also want to extend our heartfelt thanks to Dr. Matt Lockhart, who lovingly cared for our previous dog before she passed. He’s a solid, reliable vet who brings warmth and competence to every interaction.

Drs. Andrea and Weston Richter, along with Dr. Matt Lockhart, are outstanding professionals. They combine deep expertise with genuine compassion. The staff, vet techs and office manager  are also outstanding and deserve special thanks. Especially Taylor and Jan. If you’re looking for a veterinary team that can handle both routine care and life-or-death emergencies, look no further. They saved our dog’s life, and we are forever grateful.

My beloved Chihuahua mix suddenly became severely ill on a Saturday evening last June; he began vomiting everything in his stomach and his diarrhea had blood in it.  My regular veterinary office was closed for the rest of the weekend, so I rushed him to the nearest emergency veterinary hospital.  Upon entering this facility on Ventura Blvd. in Studio City (which will go un-named, but let me just say - it was the ABSOLUTE WORST choice I could have possibly made), I was told by the front desk staff that my minimum wait would be SIX HOURS ( I have no idea how they deem this "emergency care" with a wait time like that).  After waiting for almost TEN HOURS, and this is NOT an exaggeration, and seeing NO physician, the rude,  uncaring and uncompassionate front desk staff informed me that I would have to wait for the morning shift of doctors to arrive, which was in another 2+ hours of my dog being confined to a a crate, suffering great physical distress, and consequently lying in his own diarrhea.  I stormed out of there in the wee hours of the morning.  The next day, after getting about 90 minutes of fitful sleep, I got online to research veterinary offices that were open on Sunday.  I discovered Sherman Oaks Veterinary Group, mere minutes from my house and open on Sunday.  I called to make sure I could get in and be seen by a vet; the staff member who answered the phone could not have been more sympathetic to my plight, as I explained to her what my pet had been through the night before.  She told me to bring my dog right in, that there may be a small wait due to non-appointment, but assured me he would be seen as soon as possible.  He was seen almost immediately by Dr. Andrea Richter who determined it was a very severe case of pancreatitis.  He was treated, I was given medication to take home and my dog showed signs of improvement that very evening at what I consider, reasonable treatment and medication costs.  Dr. Andrea Richter and the staff at Sherman Oaks Veterinary Group were congenial, caring and compassionate (everything that the "emergency" facility I took my pet to, was NOT),  and they are now my regular veterinary office.  Dr. Richter took the time to sit down with me, explain what was going on and offer me long term advice and a diet plan to prevent another onset.  Sherman Oaks Veterinary Group were a Godsend!  I recommend them very, very highly!!

Around June of this year, my dog got an ear hematoma, and we took him to this vet. The doctor, who was female, communicated clearly about what was going on and told us we needed surgery. The surgery went well, and there were no complications. They told us there would be some bleeding, which was completely normal, and to bring him back once a week to check and clean his ear free of charge.

Now, in early December, my dog has developed another hematoma, this time on his other ear. I liked the way this vet handled things and we’ve been coming here for a while, so we took him again. Since this had happened before, we knew exactly what to expect. The doctor we saw was an older man, and at first, everything was going well until we were hit with the bill. They tried to charge us for many things he didn’t need, and I was very confused because, as I mentioned, this had happened before.

They performed the surgery, and when they gave my dog back to me, he was bleeding everywhere. The image I attached shows what my dog looked like right after the surgery, and the bleeding became even worse after the picture was taken. After a week, we returned so they could clean his ear, and they attempted to charge us $150, even though last time they said it was included with the surgery. It started to feel as if they were trying to squeeze as much money from us as possible.

I hate to write reviews like this especially for a vet that we’ve been coming to for such a long time, but this was completely unacceptable.
